package imported_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/imported/gen/credentials"
	server "example.com/imported/gen/http/credentials/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/security"
)

type implementation struct {
	svc.Service
	calls     int
	auth      []string
	failJWT   bool
	denyOAuth bool
}

func (s *implementation) Either(context.Context, *svc.EitherPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) Both(context.Context, *svc.BothPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) ScopedBoth(context.Context, *svc.ScopedBothPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) BasicRoles(context.Context, *svc.BasicRolesPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) BearerRoles(context.Context, *svc.BearerRolesPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) Keys(context.Context, *svc.KeysPayload) error {
	s.calls++
	return nil
}
func (s *implementation) JWTAuth(ctx context.Context, token string, scheme *security.JWTScheme) (context.Context, error) {
	s.auth = append(s.auth, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%v", scheme.Name, token, scheme.RequiredScopes))
	if s.failJWT || token != "token" {
		return ctx, fmt.Errorf("JWT denied")
	}
	return ctx, nil
}
func (s *implementation) OAuth2Auth(ctx context.Context, token string, scheme *security.OAuth2Scheme) (context.Context, error) {
	s.auth = append(s.auth, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%v", scheme.Name, token, scheme.RequiredScopes))
	if s.denyOAuth || token != "token" {
		return ctx, fmt.Errorf("OAuth denied")
	}
	return ctx, nil
}
func (s *implementation) BasicAuth(ctx context.Context, user, pass string, scheme *security.BasicScheme) (context.Context, error) {
	s.auth = append(s.auth, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s:%s", scheme.Name, user, pass))
	if user != "user" || pass != "pass" {
		return ctx, fmt.Errorf("Basic denied")
	}
	return ctx, nil
}
func (s *implementation) APIKeyAuth(ctx context.Context, key string, scheme *security.APIKeyScheme) (context.Context, error) {
	s.auth = append(s.auth, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", scheme.Name, key))
	return ctx, nil
}
func TestCandidateAuthWire(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, path, authorization, key string
		failJWT, denyOAuth             bool
		calls                          int
		auth                           []string
	}{
		{"basic", "either", "Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz", "", false, false, 1, []string{"Basic:user:pass"}},
		{"JWT", "either", "Bearer token", "", false, false, 1, []string{"Basic::", "Bearer:token:[]"}},
		{"OAuth fallback scopes", "either", "Bearer token", "", true, false, 1, []string{"Basic::", "Bearer:token:[]", "OAuth:token:[read]"}},
		{"AND both", "both", "Bearer token", "", false, false, 1, []string{"Bearer:token:[]", "OAuth:token:[]"}},
		{"AND denied", "both", "Bearer token", "", false, true, 0, []string{"Bearer:token:[]", "OAuth:token:[]"}},
		{"shared Basic roles", "basic_roles", "Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz", "", false, false, 1, []string{"Basic:user:pass", "BasicSecond:user:pass"}},
		{"shared bearer roles", "bearer_roles", "Bearer token", "", false, false, 1, []string{"Bearer:token:[]", "BearerSecond:token:[]"}},
		{"shared raw key", "keys", "", "key", false, false, 1, []string{"One:key", "Two:key"}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := &implementation{failJWT: tc.failJWT, denyOAuth: tc.denyOAuth}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(s), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/"+tc.path, nil)
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", tc.authorization)
			req.Header.Set("X-Key", tc.key)
			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
			if s.calls != tc.calls {
				t.Errorf("calls=%d want=%d status=%d body=%s", s.calls, tc.calls, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(tc.auth, s.auth) {
				t.Errorf("auth=%v want=%v", s.auth, tc.auth)
			}
			if tc.calls == 1 && rec.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
				t.Errorf("status=%d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
			}
			if tc.calls == 0 && rec.Code < 400 {
				t.Errorf("denial status=%d", rec.Code)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestCandidateMixedScopeSourceContract verifies that a shared DSL requirement
// passes each scheme only the scopes declared by that scheme.
func TestCandidateMixedScopeSourceContract(t *testing.T) {
	s := &implementation{}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(svc.NewEndpoints(s), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/scoped_both", nil)
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer token")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	want := []string{"Bearer:token:[]", "OAuth:token:[read]"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(want, s.auth) {
		t.Errorf("source scope intent changed: auth=%v want=%v", s.auth, want)
	}
}
